description: A task's ask of a person, kept by its host (state folder's inbox/) till it's answered or its task withdraws it: across the host's restarts, stopped (its run gone) then, struck through and its buttons off. Every head that may manage the asking Bot is told it as it changes (inbox_changed).

session.description: The asking task's Bot's session id.

at.description: When it was raised (seconds since the epoch).

status.description: waiting: for an answer; answered (answer: how); withdrawn: its task took it back; stopped: its run ended (or its host restarted) with it unanswered.

versions.description: Every version of it, oldest first: the last is what's answered.

proposal.description: A model's answer waiting to be confirmed, if one was asked for.

sent_to.description: The Bot it's been sent to answer (its session id), till it does.
